reasoning_trace.value: LumiPane is an intelligent interaction system that combines visible light communication signals and gesture sensing signals for integrated transmission. It leverages the dimming characteristics of a liquid crystal light valve (LCLV) and employs a demodulation scheme that combines trend and threshold techniques. The system uses a decoupling algorithm to separate the sensing signal from the communication signal, and then uses a 1DConvTrans model for gesture recognition.
